briefdescription.para: Provides a branch-prediction hint to the compiler.

detaileddescription.para: On GCC, Clang, and ICC expands to __builtin_expect((x),(y)) so the compiler can optimize the fast path. On all other compilers the macro is a no-op that simply evaluates to x.

parameterdescription.para: The expression whose value is being predicted.
The expected value of x (0 for unlikely, 1 for likely).

memberdef.name: ONNX_ASSERT
memberdef.initializer: if (_ONNX_EXPECT(!(cond), 0)) { \ std::string error_msg = ::ONNX_LIGHT_NAMESPACE::barf("%s:%u: %s: Assertion `%s` failed.", \ __FILE__, __LINE__, __func__, #cond); \ throw_assert_error(error_msg); \ }

briefdescription.para: Asserts that cond is true; throws assert_error if it is not.

detaileddescription.para: The failure message includes the source file, line number, enclosing function name, and the stringified condition. The branch is annotated as unlikely via _ONNX_EXPECT so the fast path incurs no extra overhead.

parameterdescription.para: Boolean expression that is expected to be true.

briefdescription.para: Forces macro expansion of x before it is passed to another macro.

detaileddescription.para: Useful when a variadic macro argument needs to be fully expanded prior to token-pasting or stringification by an outer macro.

memberdef.name: ONNX_ASSERTM
memberdef.initializer: if (_ONNX_EXPECT(!(cond), 0)) { \ std::string error_msg = \ ::ONNX_LIGHT_NAMESPACE::barf("%s:%u: %s: Assertion `%s` failed: " msg, __FILE__, __LINE__, \ __func__, #cond, ##__VA_ARGS__); \ throw_assert_error(error_msg); \ }

briefdescription.para: Asserts that cond is true; throws assert_error with a custom message if not.

detaileddescription.para: Combines the source location information from ONNX_ASSERT with a printf-style msg so callers can provide additional context. The resulting exception message has the form: file:line:func:Assertion`cond`failed:<formattedmsg>

parameterdescription.para: Boolean expression that is expected to be true.
printf-compatible format string describing the failure.
Additional arguments matching the format specifiers in msg.

memberdef.name: TENSOR_ASSERTM
memberdef.initializer: if (_ONNX_EXPECT(!(cond), 0)) { \ std::string error_msg = \ ::ONNX_LIGHT_NAMESPACE::barf("%s:%u: %s: Assertion `%s` failed: " msg, __FILE__, __LINE__, \ __func__, #cond, ##__VA_ARGS__); \ throw_tensor_error(error_msg); \ }

briefdescription.para: Asserts that cond is true; throws tensor_error with a custom message if not.

detaileddescription.para: Identical in structure to ONNX_ASSERTM but throws tensor_error instead of assert_error, allowing callers to catch tensor-specific failures separately.

parameterdescription.para: Boolean expression that is expected to be true.
printf-compatible format string describing the failure.
Additional arguments matching the format specifiers in msg.
